navis-inquisition-actors.name: Utter Purity
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Your Patron demands that you uphold their uncompromising ideals of purity and abhor what they deem corrupted, be it psykers, the Warp, or the works of the alien, mutant, or heretic. Transgressors are punished severely, up to amputation, execution, or arco-flagellation.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Astropath
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Astropath can make a Hard (−20) Psychic Mastery (Telepathy) Test to undergo a ritual to send or receive a message from another Astropath. This takes one hour, during which time the Astropath cannot be interrupted. The GM may modify the difficulty of the Test and the length of the ritual based on the distance between the two Astropaths and any potential warp interference.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Blind
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Astropath is blind, and automatically fails any Awareness (Sight) Tests. However, the Astropath is able to sense and interact with the world for the most part leaning on their Awareness (Psyniscience) Specialisation. The Astropath is immune to the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#blinded]{Blinded} Condition.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Soul-Bound
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Astropath has Advantage on all Tests made to resist Corruption.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Telepath
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Astropath knows the following Divination Psychic Powers: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.qWQd7R5F8FqYiX9J]{Dowsing}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.tb7ntikXWkv1mDLd]{Forewarning}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.a8LvONbMdLRtynKS]{Prescience}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.3vquTkVELDNBVsZL]{Psychometry}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.JD8KXpaybkhEvnUm]{Scrying Gaze}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.4bbAQA6kvRtfUna1]{Watchward}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Psychic Powers
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Astropath knows the following Minor Psychic Powers: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.iHemd2KVEYx2olv7]{Smite}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.plATcbLJsFW1evOT]{Soulsight}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Ambusher
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Imperial Bounty Hunter can attempt to make a Stealth Test as part of their Movement if the Zone they are in has Cover.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Relentless Pursuit
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: If the Imperial Bounty Hunter deals a Wound to their quarry, they have Advantage on all Awareness and Navigation (Tracking) Tests to find their quarry until the Imperial Bounty Hunter sleeps. The Imperial Bounty Hunter also gains +1 SL to Attack Tests targeting their quarry.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Лазанье
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Practised ability to safely and efficiently traverse vertical surfaces. Frequently useful on both Feral and Hive Worlds. Valuable in combat if one has to scale the side of a servo-hauler to get the drop on a heretical demagogue.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Разминирование
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#dexterity-(ag)]{Dexterity}

Practical rote instruction in the various techniques and prayers used to harmlessly deactivate explosive devices and disarm trap mechanisms. Defuse requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech Skill}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Оценка
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#logic-(int)]{Logic}

The ability to assess relative worth based on perceived qualities. Useful for determining the value of practical goods and equipment, or the soundness of a given structure or device.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Пистолеты
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#ranged-(bs)]{Ranged}

Extensive training in the use of handguns, such as laspistols, bolt pistols, autopistols, stub revolvers, and similar firearms.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Аугметика
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Studied in the use and repair of different types of augmetic devices. Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Инженерное дело
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of the construction, use, and restoration of technological and mechanical devices. Encompasses the crafting of such items, as well as weapons and explosives. Within the Imperium, the Adeptus Mechanicus considers this entire branch of knowledge to be their exclusive right and will punish those who use it, or even study it, without their sanction. Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Безопасность
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of how to interact with the Machine Spirits that control security devices, along with whatever other systems have been linked to the same, such as doors, thermo-regulators, weapons systems, and so forth, in order to direct them in specific ways. Accomplished through the use of binary codes, modern and ancient, along with various techniques used to sift information from datavaults, secured or otherwise. A Specialisation known to few outside the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.1oKZw1hTM7Gx5cqB]{Adeptus Mechanicus}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: True Faith
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Devout has 1 point of Fate.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Hernkyn Crackshot
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: When a Hernkyn Yaegir takes an Aim or Hide Action, the Penetration value of the weapon they are using increases by +1 for its next attack. Weapons without the Penetration Trait are not affected.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Blood Fervour
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: When a Critical Wound is dealt within Long Range of Mizrax, he can pick a Zone within Long Range and cause characters in that Zone to enter a frenzied state. They must make a Difficult (−10) Discipline (Composure) Test at the start of their next turn. If they fail, their StrB increases by +1, and they are immune to the Frightened Condition, but they must attempt to engage the nearest enemy in melee combat.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Favoured by Khorne
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: A Difficult (−10) Awareness (Psyniscience) Test at Immediate Range can detect ripples and imperfections in realspace that surround Mizrax. If Mizrax is defeated without being reminded of his past honours, a rift opens, unleashing [[/r 1d10]] @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.r38KjnD2RWhYIykh]{Bloodletters}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Deny the Witch
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: When a psyker within Medium Range of Gaazrek Weavemaster manifests a Psychic Power, it may use its Reaction to attempt to disrupt it. Gaazrek Weavemaster makes a Willpower Test with the same Difficulty as the Psychic Power. If it succeeds, subtract its SL from the psyker's SL. This may reduce their SL below 1 and cause the Psychic Power to fail.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Ephemeral Form
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Gaazrek Weavemaster is immune to the Penetrating and Rend Weapon Traits.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Energy of Change
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: If Gaazrek Weavemaster’s Coruscating Flames inflict a Critical Wound, the target must immediately make a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test. On failure, they are transformed into a Chaos Spawn.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Lesser Daemon
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Whenever Gaazrek Weavemaster is attacked, roll [[/r 1d5]] + 2 to determine its Armour.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Psyker
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Gaazrek Weavemaster knows the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.iHemd2KVEYx2olv7]{Smite} Psychic Power. As a daemon, it has no limit to its Warp Threshold.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Source of Corruption
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Witnessing Gaazrek Weavemaster is @Corruption[minor]{Minor Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Discipline (Psychic) Test to resist 1 Corruption Point. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1. Additionally, physical contact with Gaazrek Weavemaster is @Corruption[moderate]{Moderate Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test to resist 2 Corruption Points. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: True Faith
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Ministorum Priest has 1 point of Fate.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: War Hymn
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Ministorum Priest makes a Presence (Leadership) Test as an Action to intone a Hymn of Battle. If they succeed, they may choose an ally that can hear them from the Ecclesiarchy Faction. The next time that ally makes a melee attack, they may make a second melee attack.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Aeldrai War Construct
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Wraithguard is immune to the Blinded, Fatigued, Frightened, and Poisoned Conditions. It is equipped with either a Wraithcannon or D-Scythe, but never both.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: D-Scythe
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The D-Scythe only deals damage to creatures with souls. It makes no sound and produces no visible damage, causing characters it kills to simply become lifeless husks. Critical Wounds it afflicts cause the resulting body parts to become forever debilitated.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Argent Tongue
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Intuition Tests targeting the Merchant Trader are made with Disadvantage.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Immovable Mercantile
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Merchant Trader has a Resolve of 3 whenever making a trade deal, and has Advantage on Discipline (Composure) Tests.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Инженерное дело
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of the construction, use, and restoration of technological and mechanical devices. Encompasses the crafting of such items, as well as weapons and explosives. Within the Imperium, the Adeptus Mechanicus considers this entire branch of knowledge to be their exclusive right and will punish those who use it, or even study it, without their sanction. Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Curse of the Walking Pox
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Characters who die due to Damage inflicted by a Poxwalker’s melee attacks return to life after [[/r 1d100]] minutes as a Poxwalker with Wounds equal to their Corruption.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Source of Corruption
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Witnessing a Poxwalker is @Corruption[minor]{Minor Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Discipline (Psychic) Test to resist 1 Corruption Point. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1. Additionally, physical contact with a Poxwalker is @Corruption[moderate]{Moderate Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude (Endurance) Test to resist 2 Corruption Points. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Зрение
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Advanced capacity for perceiving important details and training in noticing elements that seem even a little incongruous.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Кулачный бой
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Experience in the brutal art of pugilism. Covers everything from fighting with bare hands or brass knuckles, through to inflicting devastating blows with a mighty @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{Power Fist}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Следы
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#navigation-(int)]{Navigation}

Extensive training in how to read the marks left by the passage of others, in order to follow them, but also to determine information such as their numbers, if they are carrying a heavy load or travelling light, if they were in a hurry, and so on.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Запугивание
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Бесшумное движение
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Stealth}

Trained facility for moving soundlessly and avoiding drawing attention. Move Silently is usually opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.w8inHqYAM5sSUmg8]{Awareness (Hearing)}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Blade Artist
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Whenever Varon makes a melee attack with a bladed weapon, it gains the Penetrating (+1) Trait.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Blade Master
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Varon can make two attacks with his Sybarite Swords on his turn. He does not suffer Disadvantage when attacking with two melee weapons simultaneously. When wielding two melee weapons, they gain the Defensive Trait.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Sadistic Raider
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Drukhari within Long Range of Varon can choose the result of their roll when their Power from Pain Trait activates (Varon gains the chosen bonus also).

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Conduit to the Warp
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Each time the Daemonhost takes a Critical Wound, roll [[/r 1d100]] on the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-tables.RollTable.9aSbu2mswOOI43J1]{Psychic Phenomena} Table. When the Daemonhost dies, roll [[/r 1d100]] on the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-tables.RollTable.2YYlAUyaVIt4bZVa]{Perils of the Warp} Table

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Malefic Warding
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Daemonhost has additional Critical Wounds equal to its Willpower Bonus (included above). It also grants allies within Long Range and who have had their true names inscribed upon its wards or flesh an additional +[[/r 1d5]] Armour.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Source of Corruption
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Witnessing the Daemonhost is @Corruption[minor]{Minor Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Discipline (Psychic) Test to resist 1 Corruption Point. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1. Additionally, physical contact with the Daemonhost is @Corruption[moderate]{Moderate Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test to resist 2 Corruption Points. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1. (Note: Characters in the company of the Daemonhost must make these Tests at least once a day, when witnessing the Daemonhost for the first time in that period.)

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Sarcophagus of Chains
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Daemonhost is contained within a shroud of chains and malefic wards. This keeps the Daemonhost docile and easier to transport. Freeing it from these chains takes an Action, at which point it is free to move and act on its own will, and its Resolve increases to 5.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Note
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The above attacks can be opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.T3pf1AmXi3Qnm6ev#deny-the-witch!]{Deny the Witch}! like any other Psychic Power.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Disgustingly Resilient
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Whenever the Reaper would suffer one or more Wounds, it may make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test. If it succeeds, it reduces the amount of Wounds suffered by the SL.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Lesser Daemon
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Whenever the Reaper is attacked, roll [[/r 1d5]] + 3 to determine its Armour.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Source of Corruption
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Witnessing the Reaper is @Corruption[Minor Exposure]. Make a Challenging (+0) Discipline (Psychic) Test to resist 1 Corruption Point. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1. Additionally, physical contact with the Reaper is @Corruption[moderate]{Moderate Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test to resist 2 Corruption Points. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Extra Appendages
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: On its turn, Valastra can attack two targets if they are both in Immediate Range — one with its Greatwsord, the other with its Serrated Claws.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Source of Corruption
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Witnessing Valastra is a @Corruption[minor]{Minor Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Discipline Test to resist 1 Corruption Point. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1. Additionally, physical contact with Valastra is @Corruption[moderate]{Moderate Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test to resist 2 Corruption Points. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Tempt with Obsession
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Characters who have been Corrupted by Valastra have Advantage on any Intelligence (Logic) or (Lore) Tests but suffer Disadvantage on any Willpower (Discipline) or (Presence) Tests (this effect remains until the character has removed their Corruption).

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Lesser Daemon
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Whenever Valastra is attacked, roll [[/r 1d5]] + 2 to determine its Armour.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Неустанность
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Уклонение
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#reflexes-(ag)]{Reflexes}

Capacity for avoiding injury or accident through quick movements designed to sidestep the danger. Can be used to defend yourself in combat against melee and ranged attacks. While the unaugmented cannot directly dodge bullets, they can avoid being shot by swiftly removing themselves from the line of fire.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Anti-grav Field Generator
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Servo-Skull can fly.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Programmed to Serve
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Every Servitor has a preprogrammed task to perform. They will continue to operate on their programmed functions until reprogrammed with a Hard (−20) Tech (Augmetics) Test. The individual that programmed (or re-programmed) the Servitor can give it simple orders.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Мощь
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Неустанность
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Аугметика
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Studied in the use and repair of different types of augmetic devices. Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Biological Warfare
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Up to two other Genestealer Cult characters accompanying the Biophagus gain the Chemical Vials Attack.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Twisted Science
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
As an Action on his turn, the Biophagus can use his Injector Goad on an Genestealer Cult ally within Immediate Range, dosing them with a gene-brew that enhances their abilities. Roll [[/r 1d10]] and apply the related effect. Each character can only be affected by this Trait once per encounter.

1-2 Heightened Sense: The character has Advantage to all Awareness, Intuition and Reflexes Tests.

3-4 Regenerating Mass: At the start of the character’s turns, they heal wounds equal to their Toughness Bonus.

5-6 Hulking Frame: The character gains additional wounds equal to their Toughness Bonus, and adds their Strength Bonus in SL to any Strength Tests and Melee Damage.

7-8 Carapaced Flesh: The character gains +2 Armour.

9-0 Combat Instincts: The character has Advantage to all Dicsipline, Melee, Ranged and Stealth Tests.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Forbidden knowledge of Genestealer Cult biology
Raging Onslaught
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: If one of Mizrax’s Faithful takes a Wound, they have Advantage on their next Melee Attack Test.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Mark of Khorne
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: +10 Weapon Skill and Strength. The +10 Strength increases Wounds by +1 (already included above).

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Вкус
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Superior ability to discern various flavours, including the signs of certain poisons and drugs.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Психическое чутьё
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Psykers can be trained to use their connection to the immaterium in order to discern areas where realspace is being, or has been, disrupted due to the intrusion of the warp. This allows them to detect the presence of warp entities and even locate other psykers, so long as they draw on the empyrean to use their psychic abilities. Psyniscience requires the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.3GLGsYiH5LiKgYjE]{Psyker} Talent, though prolonged exposure to warp phenomena and at the GM's discretion may allow others to take a single advance in this skill.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Психосилы
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#discipline-(wil)]{Discipline}

Advanced training in mentally resisting various psychic powers that can unduly influence or suborn one’s mind.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Кулачный бой
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Experience in the brutal art of pugilism. Covers everything from fighting with bare hands or brass knuckles, through to inflicting devastating blows with a mighty @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{Power Fist}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Следы
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#navigation-(int)]{Navigation}

Extensive training in how to read the marks left by the passage of others, in order to follow them, but also to determine information such as their numbers, if they are carrying a heavy load or travelling light, if they were in a hurry, and so on.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Запугивание
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Бесшумное движение
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Stealth}

Trained facility for moving soundlessly and avoiding drawing attention. Move Silently is usually opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.w8inHqYAM5sSUmg8]{Awareness (Hearing)}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Bound Mount
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Disc of Tzeentch can Fly, and can carry a rider upon it. Characters bound to it are immune to its Source of Corruption Trait, so long as they have at least 2 Corruption.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Source of Corruption
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Witnessing the Disc of Tzeentch is @Corruption[minor]{Minor Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Discipline (Psychic) Test to resist 1 Corruption Point. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1. Additionally, physical contact with the Disc of Tzeentch is @Corruption[moderate]{Moderate Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test to resist 2 Corruption Points. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Lesser Daemon
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Whenever the Disc of Tzeentch is attacked, roll [[/r 1d5]] + 1 to determine its Armour.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Genestealer Mutation
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Acolyte Hybrids are connected to the Genestealer Broodmind. They gain Advantage on Discipline Tests when within Long Range of a Genestealer Psyker.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Helping Hand
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: This creature has an additional limb. They may use it to wield an additional One-handed weapon and use it in combat.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Powerful Telepath
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Murmurer can use the following Psychic Powers: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.owV6X67ajuIlIiK7]{Beacon}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.iF1qxYZdS6GKxaVk]{Call Vermin}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-items.Item.hkQ5a28KjUr21qBT]{Cipher Seed}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.XnKX6A6hVzeXsGld]{Compel}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.FlK5TFyjJNmgnExw]{Dominate}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.I6NTqen3Srp90dyW]{Dread Presence}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.dXuovICcPa2cssAn]{Erasure}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-items.Item.lwD2p2jSEj6Io81A]{Hallucinate}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.sZluux2xrMuK4w1H]{Mental Interrogation}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.42dhMCtTnzvxtiUM]{Psychic Static}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.plATcbLJsFW1evOT]{Soulsight}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.23AM9iBKKeWZKZNj]{Telepathic Link}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Puppet Master
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: While dominating a creature, the Murmurer has direct control of their body and can perceive through their senses. He can also manifest his Psychic Powers through that body as though it were his own.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Transient Body
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: All Characteristics except for Int, Per, Wil, Fel, are determined by the specific body Murmurer controls at any given time (base values are his own).

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Warp Threshold
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: 6 (Whilst plugged into the Emanation Engine, any Warp Charge that the Murmurer would generate locally is automatically dissipated).

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Amplified Power
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Emanation Engine drastically extends the range of Kho’s psyniscience and Psychic Powers, allowing him to detect and target creatures at any range within the sector. Additionally, the Murmurer has Advantage on Manifest Tests.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Призыв вредителей
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
Cognomens: Verminspeak, Rat-tongue, Crawlers Plea

You summon and compel simple creatures to fly or scurry at your whim. Until the start of your next turn, you gain control of vermin in the area (you don't need to see them), amassing them as a swarm that fills one Zone within Medium Range. If the vermin crawl, the swarm's Zone is @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#difficult-terrain]{Difficult Terrain}. If the swarm flies, its Zone is @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#obscured]{Lightly Obscured}. As a free action once on your turn, you can command the swarm to move to an adjacent Zone within Long Range of you.

Alternatively, you can summon and control a single vermin, which emerges within Medium Range. As a free action once on your turn, you can direct it to perform a simple task, such as fetching a keycard or gnawing through bindings.

You immediately lose control of vermin beyond Medium Range. This power does not grant you the ability to communicate with vermin, only command them.

Specialisation in Telepathy applies to this power's Manifest Test.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: For Chaos!
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: A Traitor Guardsman can use their action to suffer [[/r 1d5]] Damage that ignores Armour and gain the Prone Condition to give allies in the same Zone Advantage on their next Attack Test.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Следы
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#navigation-(int)]{Navigation}

Extensive training in how to read the marks left by the passage of others, in order to follow them, but also to determine information such as their numbers, if they are carrying a heavy load or travelling light, if they were in a hurry, and so on.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Ranked Fire
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: As an Action, the Traitor Enforcer can command all Traitor Guardsmen in their Zone to fire their Ranged Weapon on their next turn, granting them an additional +1 SL.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Worthless Lives
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: When in the same Zone as an Enforcer, Desperate Traitor Guardsmen do not Flee or Surrender.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Обоняние
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Aptitude for noting and identifyingparticularly distinct or unusual aromas. Some rare augmentations and genetic enhancements allow those imbued with them to track others entirely by scent alone.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Аугметика
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Studied in the use and repair of different types of augmetic devices. Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Argent Tongue
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Intuition Tests targeting the Smuggler are made with Disadvantage.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Home Turf
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Smuggler has +1 Resolve when in conversation.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Heavily Augmented
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Tech-Priest has @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.zK3ii7HUPfnQGKtg]{Augmetic Arms}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.PS24p896oNkNxwc4]{Augmetic Legs}, an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.6VeObvauzrXSw5nO]{Augmetic Heart}, an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.gMiilnjEIZawYcfG]{Augmetic Respiratory System}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.HkhEg8qCUV0oZxOt]{Augmetic Sensory Organs}, a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.DN4ZI8z7SqJjsney]{Utility Mechadendrite}, an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.2SkHTUxjqUxiyW6b]{Optical Mechadendrite}, and a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.wRIE5K6YuMtymmm0]{Biomechanical Interface}. The benefits of these Augmetics are already included.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Augmetic Heart
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: As an Action, the Tech-Priest makes a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test. If they are successful, they remove a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Bleeding} Condition from themself.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Augmetic Respiratory System
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Tech-Priest gains +2 SL to Fortitude Tests to resist the effects of airborne toxins and poisonous gases.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Biomechanical Interface
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Tech-Priest gains +1 SL to Tech Tests for operating a machine with a suitable connection, such as many vehicles, environmental processors, and manufactorum assemblers.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Optical Mechadendrite
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Can access cramped areas to give visual data and includes a stablight which can remove the Dark Environmental Trait from a Zone.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Ремесленный механодендрит
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Functions as a Combi-tool and a melee weapon.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Blade Artist
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Whenever the Mandrake makes a melee attack with a bladed weapon, it gains the Penetrating (+1) Trait.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Shadow Creature
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Mandrake always takes half damage, unless it takes damage from pyschic abilities or phenomena.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Fade Away
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: As an Action on their turn, the Mandrake can become invisible to the eye while inside Zones with Dark, Obscure, or Poorly Lit Environmental Traits, and has Advantage on Stealth Tests. They remain in this state until they take a non-movement Action (such as making an attack, or interacting with an object).

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Мощь
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Неустанность
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Аугметика
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Studied in the use and repair of different types of augmetic devices. Most augmetics are mechanical or electrical augmetic substitutes for Human biological parts, many with enhanced capacities, though some offer entirely new capabilities. Augmetics requires at least 1 Advance in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#medicae-(int)]{Medicae} Skill.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Bureaucratic Boldness
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Administratum Adept has a Resolve of 3 whenever dealing with paperwork, tithes, or any other bureaucratic conversation.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Шифры
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#linguistics-(int)]{Linguistics}

Training in identifying, deciphering, and using secret writing codes. Some ciphers are clearly coded communications that may require a literary key of some kind to unlock, others are messages carefully disguised within other writings.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Запретное (Разное)
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#lore-(int)]{Lore}

Knowledge and training in a specific subject that is utterly suppressed within the Imperium. Knowing information about aliens or psykers without specific dispensation from a powerful individual or group can get you in serious trouble. True knowledge of daemons lead to summary execution. Any knowledge of the immaterium, beyond common myth, is typically strictly obscured within the Imperium, as is real knowledge about the Adeptus Astartes. Each Forbidden Lore requires taking a corresponding @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Lbm6mRMiqSGHq9GD]{Forbidden Knowledge} Talent in order to learn it.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Адептус Терра
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#lore-(int)]{Lore}

Knowledge not only of the Adeptus Terra itself, but of the many Adepta that make up the structure of the Imperium. This specialisation does not necessarily confer knowledge of any but the most well known members of any particular organisation, but it does cover knowledge of the roles and responsibilities of these organisations and their position with the Imperium at large.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Malefic Psyker
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
The Rogue Psyker can use the following Psychic Powers:

Minor Psychic Powers: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.iF1qxYZdS6GKxaVk]{Call Vermin}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.I6NTqen3Srp90dyW]{Dread Presence}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.6piNqY3oQ4WVndT0]{Float}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.8Y2GkGqdRW4fgtt2]{Ill Omen}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.dbY2lsnqcGTU9ySA]{Jinx}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.4PwcP3ziykhvMnEr]{Nova}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.iHemd2KVEYx2olv7]{Smite}.

Biomancy Psychic Powers: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Z1iAai8os7wLhSD8]{Affliction}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.eYVRPE01hIztBgtI]{Bio-Lightning}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.mfnf7gC27VsppIsN]{Haemorrhage}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.a9DufcxlzYqbOVo7]{Life Leech}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.NEv8PYXJe0scDiL3]{Wither}.

Divination Psychic Powers: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.xfNouLz2vwT0L7Gr]{Question the Warp}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.JD8KXpaybkhEvnUm]{Scrying Gaze}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.CR3c7PVCtTdAEF1W]{Twist Fate}.

Telekinesis Psychic Powers: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Q9XWNAmAzaLRgQ89]{Gate of Infinity}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.IoFNznc46ljGmm9H]{Vortex of Doom}.

Telepathy Psychic Powers: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.XnKX6A6hVzeXsGld]{Compel}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.FlK5TFyjJNmgnExw]{Dominate}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.sZluux2xrMuK4w1H]{Mental Interrogation}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.61LtbSXGELhbGC6c]{Psychic Shriek}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.U4GZLrdv7mLbK6bz]{Terrifying Visions}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Source of Corruption
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: Physical contact with the Rogue Psyker is @Corruption[minor]{Minor Exposure}. Make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test to resist 1 Corruption Point. Every SL reduces the number of Corruption Points gained by 1.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Unrestrained Power
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Rogue Psyker can choose to have Advantage on any Psychic Mastery Test. If they do so, they must double the Warp Charge gained.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Aura of Discipline
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: All allies of the Commissar that can see them gain +1 SL to Discipline (Fear) Tests.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Stalwart
navis-inquisition-actors.desc: The Commissar has Advantage on Tests to resist or end the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Frightened} Condition.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: a bookmarked copy of the Imperial Infantryman’s Uplifting Primer
Лазанье
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Practised ability to safely and efficiently traverse vertical surfaces. Frequently useful on both Feral and Hive Worlds. Valuable in combat if one has to scale the side of a servo-hauler to get the drop on a heretical demagogue.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Бег
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Greater capability for moving at speed over longer distances. Useful for catching fleeing foes, and escaping from dangerous opponents.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Психическое чутьё
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Psykers can be trained to use their connection to the immaterium in order to discern areas where realspace is being, or has been, disrupted due to the intrusion of the warp. This allows them to detect the presence of warp entities and even locate other psykers, so long as they draw on the empyrean to use their psychic abilities. Psyniscience requires the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.3GLGsYiH5LiKgYjE]{Psyker} Talent, though prolonged exposure to warp phenomena and at the GM's discretion may allow others to take a single advance in this skill.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Психосилы
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#discipline-(wil)]{Discipline}

Advanced training in mentally resisting various psychic powers that can unduly influence or suborn one’s mind.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Обаяние
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#rapport-(fel)]{Rapport}

Skilled at being exceedingly agreeable and pleasant company, leading to increased ability to make ‘reasonable’ requests of one’s new friends. Charm is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Равновесие
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#reflexes-(ag)]{Reflexes}

Practice in keeping on one’s feet, despite uncertain ground, pools of slippery unguents, or treacherous walkways.

navis-inquisition-actors.name: Бесшумное движение
navis-inquisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#stealth-(ag)]{Stealth}

Trained facility for moving soundlessly and avoiding drawing attention. Move Silently is usually opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.w8inHqYAM5sSUmg8]{Awareness (Hearing)}.

navis-requisition-actors.name: Инженерное дело
navis-requisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#tech-(int)]{Tech}

Knowledge of the construction, use, and restoration of technological and mechanical devices. Encompasses the crafting of such items, as well as weapons and explosives. Within the Imperium, the Adeptus Mechanicus considers this entire branch of knowledge to be their exclusive right and will punish those who use it, or even study it, without their sanction. Notably, an individual that knows only how to assemble or repair a device by rote need not have this Specialisation.

navis-requisition-actors.name: Аэронавтика
navis-requisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#piloting-(ag)]{Piloting}

Advanced training in how to operate flying vehicles, from transports to combat aircraft. This specialisation is sufficient for taking capable craft from orbit down to a planet, but not for performing complex manoeuvres outside of a planet's atmosphere.

navis-requisition-actors.name: Военная техника
navis-requisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#piloting-(ag)]{Piloting}

Advanced training in how to operate military ground vehicles, such as tanks. Typically, training in this specialisation is given by Astra Militarum instructors, to characters of sufficient rank.

navis-requisition-actors.name: Гражданская техника
navis-requisition-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#piloting-(ag)]{Piloting}

Advanced training in how to operate nonmilitary ground vehicles such as cargo haulers or personal transports.

navis-voll-actors.name: Вызвать подкрепление
navis-voll-actors.desc: While in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-voll-journals.JournalEntry.0sTvCVRuh5Wpawt9.JournalEntryPage.eiMwmm7AQZLlFOkn#f.-the-float]{Float}, as an Action, Trace can call for backup on her Vox Bead. All Marauders hear this call within 1 mile. Backup usually arrives in [[/r 1d5]] Rounds and consists of a mix of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.ZUWBWGM4eH7xFZ8P]{Dregs} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.bB0rMr6Gez3M9bME]{Gangers}.

navis-voll-actors.name: Командир налётчиков
navis-voll-actors.desc: As an Action, Trace may make a Challenging (+0) Presence (Leadership) Test. For every SL, a member of Trace’s Marauders within Medium Range may spend their Reaction to take an immediate action.

navis-voll-actors.name: Я знаю свою машину
navis-voll-actors.desc: Restax has Advantage on all Piloting Tests in her Cargo-8, including any Tech Tests to repair or maintain it.

navis-voll-actors.name: Богословие
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#lore-(int)]{Lore}

Training in the Imperial Creed, including various sects and interpretations. Passing knowledge of the Cult Mechanicus. Only cursory knowledge at best of any heretical sects of the Imperial Creed and none whatsoever of any forbidden cults. Theology requires at least 1 Advance in @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.uIycnZ1DuUJFFO0c]{Linguistics (High Gothic)}.

navis-voll-actors.name: Двуручное оружие
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of larger swords, bigger axes, heavier maces, and other melee weapons that require two hands to use, along with various polearms such as spears and halberds.

navis-voll-actors.name: Бесстрашие
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Harbinger is immune to the Frightened Condition.

navis-voll-actors.name: Двуручный жнец
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Harbinger has grown adept at swinging his power sycthe in wide, destructive arcs. In his hands the weapon gains the Spread Trait, though his attacks never target himself. If his allies fall to his blade, however, this is no less than the Emperor’s will.

navis-voll-actors.name: Плаванье
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Better aptitude at swimming through liquids, typically water. Essential on some worlds with planet-spanning oceans, and almost unknown on others.

navis-voll-actors.name: Лазанье
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Practised ability to safely and efficiently traverse vertical surfaces. Frequently useful on both Feral and Hive Worlds. Valuable in combat if one has to scale the side of a servo-hauler to get the drop on a heretical demagogue.

navis-voll-actors.name: Осязание
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Capacity to feel unusual vibrations which indicate the passage of subterranean vehicles and weapon systems. Trained to discern the origin of fabrics and unusual materials by feel. Useful for detecting pickpockets.

navis-voll-actors.name: Окружение
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Training in learning to continually read the surrounding environment, noting unusual mistakes in layout, furtive steps, concealed shapes, or ominous patterns of behaviour which indicate something is wrong.

navis-voll-actors.name: Скользкий землерой
navis-voll-actors.desc: When in shallow pools of liquid or atop soft earth, the Acynadi Beta-3 can make a Hide Action to burrow out of sight. It can also do this as a free action immediately after making the Disengage Action.

navis-voll-actors.name: Лазанье
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

navis-voll-actors.desc:

navis-voll-actors.desc:

navis-voll-actors.name: Запугивание
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.

navis-voll-actors.name: Вытянутая туша
navis-voll-actors.desc: When the Acynadi Gamma-7 Charges, its target must make a Challenging (+0) Reflexes (Balance) Test to avoid being knocked Prone.

navis-voll-actors.name: Скользкий землерой
navis-voll-actors.desc: When in shallow pools of liquid or atop soft earth, the Acynadi Gamme-7 can make a Hide Action to burrow out of sight. It can also do this as a free action immediately after making the Disengage Action.

navis-voll-actors.name: Стенолаз
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Acynadi Delta-5 can climb most surfaces without making a Test. When it attacks or defends against a target from above, it gains Advantage.

navis-voll-actors.name: Мощь
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.

navis-voll-actors.name: Неустанность
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

navis-voll-actors.name: Боль
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Increased capability for resisting torture and doing one’s duty despite injuries, due to extensive training in withstanding pain.

navis-voll-actors.name: Кулачный бой
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Experience in the brutal art of pugilism. Covers everything from fighting with bare hands or brass knuckles, through to inflicting devastating blows with a mighty @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Tm38HWpxtnkcrmKl]{Power Fist}.

navis-voll-actors.name: Своя территория
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Ogryn Ganger has +1 Resolve and Advantage on Discipline, Presence, Navigation, and Stealth Tests if it is in its own Gang's territory.

navis-voll-actors.name: Огринская мощь
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Ogryn Ganger has +10 to Strength and Toughness but −10 to Intelligence and Fellowship.

navis-voll-actors.name: Властный голос
navis-voll-actors.desc: Lord Felputh is always sure he’s right, even when he’s lying. He gains +1 Resolve and Advantage on any Social Test, except when engaging with a character of higher social or Imperial rank.

navis-voll-actors.name: Верный Предвестнику
navis-voll-actors.desc: As long as the Harbinger is conscious and fighting, the Vertexis Cultist gains Advantage on any Discipline (Fear) Test, and their Resolve increases to 3. If the Harbinger falls, their Resolve drops to 0, and they flee.

navis-voll-actors.name: Страх
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#discipline-(wil)]{Discipline}

Mentally hardened to stand firm in the face of the unnatural fear caused by exposure to heretical and corrupt beings. Fear is often used to resist and recover from the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#frightened]{Frightened} Condition.

navis-voll-actors.name: Левая рука Сина
navis-voll-actors.desc: Corbid can use her action to command a member of the Court of Sihn within Medium range to make an immediate action.

navis-voll-actors.name: Видения Сина
navis-voll-actors.desc: If Corbid makes a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.dZFX8HOdsFDpI7l0#resolve]{Look Out, Sir!} action to protect Markis Sihn, she makes an Easy (+20) Reflexes (Dodge) Test to do so.

navis-voll-actors.name: Бюрократическая уверенность
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Overseer has a Resolve of 3 whenever dealing with paperwork, tithes, or any other bureaucratic conversation.

navis-voll-actors.name: Главный надсмотрщик
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Overseer can use Presence (Intimidation) instead of Presence (Leadership) when dealing with members of the Administratum. As an Action, the Overseer can command any Troop of the Administratum to immediately take an Action.

navis-voll-actors.name: Неустанность
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

navis-voll-actors.name: Запретное
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#linguistics-(int)]{Linguistics}

Those possessed of this skill understand a language or form of communication that is either highly restricted or prohibited within the Imperium. With few exceptions, it is considered heretical to know the languages of aliens; however, the Sisters of the Orders Dialogus are frequently granted special dispensation from the Adeptus Ministorum to learn such in pursuit of their duties. Some xenos languages, such as the Kroot’s, are unpronounceable by a Human tongue without augmentation. While some languages are considered too profane to speak, others are too holy for common knowledge. The Lingua-technis of the Adeptus Mechanicus is a forbidden language that few outside their order have ever learned, in part, because it is based on binary machine code that all but the most gifted individuals require cybernetic implants to speak. Thoughtmark, the form of sign language used by the Sisters of Silence, is also known to very few outsiders. Each Forbidden Language requires taking a corresponding @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.Lbm6mRMiqSGHq9GD]{Forbidden Knowledge} Talent in order to learn it.

navis-voll-actors.name: Кулачный бой
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

navis-voll-actors.name: Лидерство
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Trained to inspire others to put in their best efforts to achieve a desired goal. This can range anywhere from motivating a few clerks to finish a long survey in record time, to giving a group of desperate soldiers the courage to charge a fortified enemy bunker.

navis-voll-actors.name: Звериная ярость
navis-voll-actors.desc: When Talgore makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +1 SL on his next attack.

navis-voll-actors.name: Бычий натиск
navis-voll-actors.desc: When Talgore Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

navis-voll-actors.name: Колдун-псайкер
navis-voll-actors.desc: Arkt Talgore can use the following Minor Psychic Powers: Call Vermin, Dread Presence, Smite.

navis-voll-actors.name: Одноручное оружие
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

navis-voll-actors.name: Допрос
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

Aptitude in a variety of techniques designed to elicit answers out of a subject. A skilled interrogator implies pressure in many ways, subtle and not, in order to discover as much information as they can, even when a subject is cooperative. Interrogation is not physical torture, though undergoing a long interrogation may certainly feel agonising. Interrogation is opposed by the target's @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)} or @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.hu6z7RnzzKS830Av]{Endurance (Pain)}.

navis-voll-actors.name: Запугивание
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#presence-(wil)]{Presence}

navis-voll-actors.name: Вызвать подкрепление
navis-voll-actors.desc: As an Action, a Vigilite can call for backup. All Macharian Vigilites in a 1 mile radius respond in [[/r 1d10]] Rounds (or minutes if out of combat).

navis-voll-actors.name: Инкарцератус
navis-voll-actors.desc: When a Vigilite is Grappling an individual they can Manacle them as a Free Action

navis-voll-actors.name: Засадник
navis-voll-actors.desc: Heldrax can attempt to make a Stealth Test as part of his Movement if the Zone he is in has Cover.

navis-voll-actors.name: Обучение работе с хамелеолином
navis-voll-actors.desc: Heldrax has Advantage on Stealth Tests if he does not move that turn.

navis-voll-actors.name: Ответный удар ловчего
navis-voll-actors.desc: If an enemy is wounded within Short Range of Heldrax he can use his Reaction to order a Heldrax’s Stalkers member within hearing to make an immediate Action against that target (this uses the character’s Reaction).

navis-voll-actors.name: Истинная вера
navis-voll-actors.desc: Caul has 1 point of Fate.

navis-voll-actors.name: Сжечь ведьму
navis-voll-actors.desc: When a psyker within Short Range of Caul Manifests a power, Caul may use his Reaction to make an immediate @UUID[.Pw1HijVPDKGXJYlM]{Hand Flamer} attack on the zone that psyker is in.

navis-voll-actors.name: Санкционированный псайкер
navis-voll-actors.desc: Caul has a Warp Threshold equal to double his Willpower bonus.

navis-voll-actors.name: Неустанность
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#fortitude-(tgh)]{Fortitude}

navis-voll-actors.desc:

navis-voll-actors.name: Одноручное оружие
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

navis-voll-actors.name: Звериная ярость
navis-voll-actors.desc: When Gelka makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +1 SL on his next attack.

navis-voll-actors.name: Бычий натиск
navis-voll-actors.desc: When Gelka Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

navis-voll-actors.name: Засадник
navis-voll-actors.desc: Vant can attempt to make a Stealth Test as part of their Movement if the Zone they are in has Cover.

navis-voll-actors.name: Обучение работе с хамелеолином
navis-voll-actors.desc: Trissa Vant has Advantage on Stealth Tests if she does not move that turn.

navis-voll-actors.name: Страж Хелдракса
navis-voll-actors.desc: When an enemy in Short Range of Heldrax attacks him, Vant may use her Reaction to make an immediate attack with her Sniper Rifle against that character.

navis-voll-actors.name: Глубокая аугментация
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Tech-Priest has @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.zK3ii7HUPfnQGKtg]{Augmetic Arms}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.PS24p896oNkNxwc4]{Augmetic Legs}, an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.6VeObvauzrXSw5nO]{Augmetic Heart}, an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.gMiilnjEIZawYcfG]{Augmetic Respiratory System}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.HkhEg8qCUV0oZxOt]{Augmetic Sensory Organs}, a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.DN4ZI8z7SqJjsney]{Utility Mechadendrite}, an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.2SkHTUxjqUxiyW6b]{Optical Mechadendrite}, and a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.wRIE5K6YuMtymmm0]{Biomechanical Interface}. The benefits of these Augmetics are already included.

navis-voll-actors.name: Аугметическое сердце
navis-voll-actors.desc: As an Action, the Tech-Priest makes a Challenging (+0) Fortitude Test. If they are successful, they remove a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Bleeding} Condition from themself.

navis-voll-actors.name: Аугметическая дыхательная система
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Tech-Priest gains +2 SL to Fortitude Tests to resist the effects of airborne toxins and poisonous gases.

navis-voll-actors.name: Биомеханический канал связи
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Tech-Priest gains +1 SL to Tech Tests for operating a machine with a suitable connection, such as many vehicles, environmental processors, and manufactorum assemblers.

navis-voll-actors.name: Оптический механодендрит
navis-voll-actors.desc: Can access cramped areas to give visual data and includes a stablight which can remove the Dark Environmental Trait from a Zone.

navis-voll-actors.name: Ремесленный механодендрит
navis-voll-actors.desc: Functions as a Combi-tool and a melee weapon.

navis-voll-actors.name: Стойкий
navis-voll-actors.desc: Echo Team Troopers have Advantage on Tests to resist or end the Frightened Condition.

navis-voll-actors.name: Мощь
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Advanced capacity for moving greater weight, breaking physical objects, and enduring heavy loads. In appropriate circumstances, an Athletics (Might) Test can be used in place of a Presence (Intimidation) Test to achieve similar aims.

navis-voll-actors.name: Неустанность
navis-voll-actors.desc:

Trained to go without sleep for significantly extended periods, pushing on through exhaustion due to greater stamina.

Applying pressure through threats, subtle or blatant, that physical chastisement and other dire fates await those that fail to do as they are told or confess all they know. Intimidation is often opposed by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.rZwUyULrgjBjGlbN]{Discipline (Composure)}. If one party is of a larger @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#size]{Size} than the other, the larger creature gains Advantage on this Test.

navis-voll-actors.name: Звериная ярость
navis-voll-actors.desc: When a Mutated Beastman makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +2 SL on his next attack.

navis-voll-actors.name: Бычий натиск
navis-voll-actors.desc: When a Mutated Beastman Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

navis-voll-actors.name: Мутация
navis-voll-actors.desc:
For each Mutated Beastman encountered, roll [[/r 1d10]] to determine, or choose its mutation:

1-4: Extra Eye — The Mutated Beastman has grown extra eyes on its head or body. They have Advantage on Awareness (Sight) Tests.

5-7: Extra Limb — The Mutated Beastman has an extra limb. They may make an additional Hoof Strike or Unarmed attack during their turn.

8-0: Grasping Tentacle — The Mutated Beastman has grown a Tentacle. Its Unarmed attacks gain the Reach and Inflict (Restrained) Traits.

navis-voll-actors.name: Одноручное оружие
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

navis-voll-actors.name: Пистолеты
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#ranged-(bs)]{Ranged}

Extensive training in the use of handguns, such as laspistols, bolt pistols, autopistols, stub revolvers, and similar firearms.

navis-voll-actors.name: Уклонение
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#reflexes-(ag)]{Reflexes}

Capacity for avoiding injury or accident through quick movements designed to sidestep the danger. Can be used to defend yourself in combat against melee and ranged attacks. While the unaugmented cannot directly dodge bullets, they can avoid being shot by swiftly removing themselves from the line of fire.

navis-voll-actors.name: Биораспад
navis-voll-actors.desc: Should Eversor Interitas perish, deeply embedded genetic kill codes trigger, driving what remains of his enhanced metabolism into overdrive. The resulting explosion threatens all those in Immediate Range, who must make a Difficult (−10) Reflexes (Dodge) Test or suffer [[/r 2d10]] damage to a random hit location.

navis-voll-actors.name: Нечеловеческая физиология
navis-voll-actors.desc: A mixture of bio-modification and auto-injected combat drugs such as Frenzon make Eversor Interitas immune to the Fatigued, Frightened, and Stunned Conditions. He also gains Advantage on any Test to resist mind-altering psychic powers and substances.

navis-voll-actors.name: Молниеносные рефлексы
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Eversor’s reflexes have been enhanced far beyond Human limits. He may dodge any ranged attack, even ones he would seem to be unaware of.

navis-voll-actors.name: Смертоносные токсины
navis-voll-actors.desc: An Eversor’s toxins are short-lived but particularly lethal. A Poisoned Condition inflicted by an Eversor’s weaponry has a duration of [[/r 1d5]][17:52]rounds, after which time the character must pass a  Challenging (+0) Fortitude (Poison) Test or die.

navis-voll-actors.name: Протоколы избыточного уничтожения
navis-voll-actors.desc: Eversor Interitas is inhumanly fast, and acts twice each round — once on its own initiative, and once again at the end of the initiative order. Additionally, any time he inflicts a Critical Wound, he may immediately make another attack.

navis-voll-actors.name: Сторожевой комплекс
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Eversor cannot be Surprised, and gains Advantage on all Awareness Tests.

navis-voll-actors.name: Бычий натиск
navis-voll-actors.desc: When Mesk Charges, he does not gain Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes Tests.

navis-voll-actors.name: Звериная ярость
navis-voll-actors.desc: When Mesk makes a successful attack or is wounded, he gains +1 SL on his next attack.

navis-voll-actors.name: Тесак стада
navis-voll-actors.desc: Mesk only has access to this weapon if he can recover one or is given one by the characters.

navis-voll-actors.name: Кулачный бой
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#melee-(ws)]{Melee}

Extensive training in the use of swords, axes, maces, and other melee weapons that can be used with a single hand.

navis-voll-actors.name: Плаванье
navis-voll-actors.desc:

Better aptitude at swimming through liquids, typically water. Essential on some worlds with planet-spanning oceans, and almost unknown on others.

navis-voll-actors.name: Лазанье
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

Practised ability to safely and efficiently traverse vertical surfaces. Frequently useful on both Feral and Hive Worlds. Valuable in combat if one has to scale the side of a servo-hauler to get the drop on a heretical demagogue.

navis-voll-actors.name: Осязание
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#awareness-(per)]{Awareness}

Capacity to feel unusual vibrations which indicate the passage of subterranean vehicles and weapon systems. Trained to discern the origin of fabrics and unusual materials by feel. Useful for detecting pickpockets.

navis-voll-actors.name: Окружение
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Training in learning to continually read the surrounding environment, noting unusual mistakes in layout, furtive steps, concealed shapes, or ominous patterns of behaviour which indicate something is wrong.

navis-voll-actors.name: Скользкий землерой
navis-voll-actors.desc: When in shallow pools of liquid or atop soft earth, the Acynadi Delta-5 can make a Hide Action to burrow out of sight. It can also do this as a free action immediately after making the Disengage Action.

navis-voll-actors.name: Стенолаз
navis-voll-actors.desc: The Acynadi Delta-5 can climb most surfaces without making a Test. When it attacks or defends against a target from above, it gains Advantage.

navis-voll-actors.name: Стойкий
navis-voll-actors.desc: Captain Pollis has Advantage on Tests to resist or end the Frightened Condition.

navis-voll-actors.name: Направленный залп
navis-voll-actors.desc: As an Action, Captain Pollis can target a Zone adjacent to one of her troopers and make a Challenging (+0) Presence (Leadership) Test. For each SL gained, a member of Echo Team within short range of her target Zone makes an immediate ranged attack on an enemy in that Zone.

navis-voll-actors.name: Мощь
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#athletics-(str)]{Athletics}

navis-voll-actors.desc:

Practised at resisting charm, intimidation, and other social pressures. Those with strong Composure are gifted at maintaining their integrity in the face of temptation.

navis-voll-actors.name: Люди
navis-voll-actors.desc:
@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#intuition-(per)]{Intuition}

Extensive practice in studying patterns of Human behaviour, allowing one to notice when someone is lying, hiding something, or acting strangely. This skill is often used to oppose @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-items.Item.nhW5AN4gHrWvmfyz]{Rapport (Deception)}.

navis-voll-actors.name: Запугивание
navis-voll-actors.desc:
